query: SELECT c.id, c.title, latest.lifecycle AS "latest?", ($3::uuid IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_members m WHERE m.channel_id = $3 AND m.conversation_id = c.id)) AS "member!" FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.lifecycle FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id = c.id AND e.lifecycle IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.seq DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true WHERE c.owner_id = $1 AND c.state = 'active' AND ($2 = '' OR c.title ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%') ORDER BY c.last_activity_at DESC, c.id LIMIT $4
